question: Niを含むL1₂型金属間化合物を抽出して。
A₃B型組成を持つ化合物を表示して。
L12型化合物の格子定数を一覧にして。
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.lattice_a,
    s.lattice_b,
    s.lattice_c
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
WHERE
    upper(regexp_replace(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g')) = 'L12'
    OR upper(regexp_replace(COALESCE(s.prototype, ''), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g')) LIKE '%L12%'
ORDER BY
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.entry_id
LIMIT 10000;
